answer: I would anchor trust in Accredited competitive swimmer registration with swimming association attestation. With a registration the association renews after meet audits, a single ledge check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the ferrous of that gap is the whole defence in one line. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the horizon of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
